The answer is most likely **D (about 75%)**, not C. My earlier tally left out many lower-middle-income countries (such as Iran, Thailand, Egypt, the Philippines, and much of Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America), and adding them pushes the total toward 70–75% of roughly 5.9 billion people. I'm still working from memory, not a checked World Bank table, so treat this as a reasoned estimate.
